examples.x: I just plucked a figure out of the air and said : ‘Would £1 000 seem reasonable to you?’

examples.x: Our travel plans are still up in the air.

senses.definition: in a way that is not friendly and suggests that you think that you are better than other people

senses.definition: the pedal in a car or other vehicle that you press with your foot to control the speed of the engine

examples.x: cat litter

a litter tray

recyclable plastic containers

examples.x: Clay is a plastic substance.

senses.definition: that seems artificial; false; not real or sincere
